name: Save changes
description: An illustrative Loom scenario, not live traffic.

steps.name: Apply your edit
steps.description: An edit in the interface asks Authoring to update the document model.

steps.name: Keep a revision
steps.description: Authoring keeps a local revision in History before requesting persistence.

steps.name: Request a save
steps.description: The editor asks the gateway to persist the updated document.

steps.name: Save document
steps.description: The gateway asks Records to store the new document state.

steps.name: Confirm saved state
steps.description: After storing the document, Records notifies the update service.

steps.name: Show saved status
steps.description: Notifications tells the editor interface that the changes were saved.
